llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent: it provides curl-based usage instructions for an external news/search API, requests no credentials or installs, and its runtime instructions align with the stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name/description advertise a news/search API and the SKILL.md contains only documentation and example curl commands that query https://agenttimes.live endpoints. The only declared runtime requirement is curl, which is appropriate and proportionate.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are limited to making HTTP GET/POST requests to the service and describe a subscription flow where the service will POST matched articles to a user-provided webhook. This is expected for a notification endpoint, but users should be aware that providing a webhook causes the service to send data to an external URL they control.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or code files; this is instruction-only and therefore does not write files or download code. Lowest-risk install profile.

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, credentials, or config paths are requested. The skill does not ask for unrelated secrets or elevated access.
dimensions.label: Credentials

llm.guidance: This skill is basically documentation for calling an external news API and appears coherent. Before installing or using it: 1) Confirm you trust https://agenttimes.live (review site reputation and TLS). 2) When using POST /subscribe, provide a secure webhook URL — do not embed secrets or tokens in the URL; ensure your endpoint validates incoming requests. 3) Be aware paid/paid-bulk endpoints exist — check pricing and rate limits before automating. 4) Sanitize and review any returned content before using it in downstream actions (avoid blindly executing or forwarding untrusted content). 5) Ensure curl is up-to-date on your system.
